title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: delivery date and expiry of a cover
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs the recording of delivery on a cover, the expiry of the cover's claim period, and the service standard for deciding claims.

## Policy clause

1. Delivery of the covered cargo, recorded when the transport document is released and the cargo leaves the terminal, sets the cover's delivery date. Every notice window and the time bar are counted from that delivery date.
2. The system expires a cover with no open claim once the product's claim time bar, in months, has run from the delivery date. This applies to a cover that is active and to a cover whose claim has been decided and closed.
3. An expired cover takes no further claim.
4. A cover with an open claim does not expire until the claim is decided.
5. Claims are decided within the product's decision service standard, in days, of the documents being complete, as a service standard.

## State table at the end of the claim time bar

| Cover state when the time bar has run | Effect |
|---|---|
| Active, no claim open | Expires |
| Closed-claim state, the claim decided | Expires |
| Open-claim state | Does not expire until the claim is decided |

## Points of judgement

**The cargo was released from the terminal but the customer says it reached the warehouse a week later. Which date starts the notice windows?** The recorded delivery date, set when the transport document is released and the cargo leaves the terminal.

**May a new notice of loss be lodged on an expired cover?** No. An expired cover takes no further claim.
